title: Plugin trust root envelope v1
description: A trust root plus the signature that authorizes it. Bootstrap accepts only a host-built-in root: a root envelope fetched from the network may never be its own anchor. Rotation must additionally carry `authorizedBy`, naming the previous root that signed it.

publicKey.description: 32-byte Ed25519 public key, standard base64 with padding. Not hex, not URL-safe: the signature payload encodes exactly this string (spec section 8.2).

signature.description: 64-byte Ed25519 signature over the canonical root payload, standard base64 with padding.

authorizedBy.description: Present only on rotation. Names the previous root that authorized this one; rotation without it is rejected because it would let anyone replace the anchor.
